displayPattern: Status LED: 3 short flashes then 1 long flash (Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump and 24VNA9 air conditioner; amber status LED on the outdoor control)
meaning: High pressure switch open: the unit steps down capacity for each occurrence and elevates to fault 84 if it happens on the lowest stage. Reset time is 6 minutes.
causes: The manual says to refer to fault 84 for causes: high outdoor or indoor load/airflow problems, overcharge, closed service valve, restriction in the filter drier or expansion device, loose or disconnected pressure switch, faulty pressure switch
diySteps: Check the outdoor coil for clogging by ice or debris and clean or de-ice it if necessary (the manual also says to troubleshoot the outdoor fan motor)
Technician: follow the fault 84 table (charge, service valves, filter drier, expansion device, pressure switch harness and connection)
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if 31 repeats or escalates to 84.
sourceTitle: Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump / 24VNA9 air conditioner Service Manual (4SM)
